section.heading: Nanticoke River.
section.text: The Nanticoke River encompasses all the waters of the Nanticoke River and its tributaries north of a line beginning at a point at or near Lat. 38° 13.950’ N., Long. 75° 58.317’ W., then running 95° (True) to a point, at or near Lat. 38° 13.633’ N., Long. 75° 53.517’ W.

para.text: Area. All of the waters upstream of a line beginning at a point at or near Lat. 38° 39.680' N., Long. 75° 47.815' W., then running 147° True to a point at or near Lat. 38° 39.653' N., Long. 75° 47.793' W.
The speed limit for the area described in §A of this regulation is 6 knots all year.
